topic: JCX Developments Ltd. homepage redesign — PM track P1 spec

questions.q: PRD §13 describes a shipped, instrumented site, but the engagement stops at HTML. What is the goal of this phase in one measurable sentence?
questions.a: Client sign-off on look & feel — an approved static HTML prototype serving as the visual/motion spec.

questions.q: The PRD specifies 11 sections with heavy bespoke motion. How much should the prototype cover?
Design principle 2 bans stock/placeholder imagery, but only 9 real assets exist. How should the prototype handle the gap?
questions.a: Use the assets already in this repo, plus existing content.

questions.q: What does the client actually review to give written sign-off?
PRD §5.1 says navy + gold; later direction said logo blue + red on white/black. Which governs?
questions.a: Explore it in P3 — leave the seed palette-agnostic and test all three across the variations.
